HanbokVisual.title: Hanbok Styles That Make You Want to Try One
HanbokVisual.intro: These looks are from Korea's official national cultural showcases — professional runway photography of the three quintessential palace styles. Pick the one that calls to you, and we'll match it to your personality and coloring.
HanbokVisual.genderToggleAria: Switch between feminine and masculine style references
HanbokVisual.notice: Images are official Korean government cultural showcase photography (Korea.net / KOCIS), licensed CC BY-SA 2.0. They represent Hanbok styling aesthetics — not an endorsement by any individual pictured, and not a guarantee of specific garment availability at rental shops.

princess-prince.name: Princess / Prince
princess-prince.tagline: Luminous pastels · Perfect for palace photos

feminine.description: The look every K-drama fan wants at Gyeongbokgung. Layers of luminous pastel silk catch the palace light beautifully — romantic, ethereal, and endlessly photogenic.
feminine.alt: Luminous pastel chima-jeogori Hanbok from Korea's official cultural fashion showcase

masculine.description: Clean, bright, and effortlessly elegant. The lighter tones of this prince style are ideal for outdoor palace photography and look stunning in couples shots.
masculine.alt: Bright and graceful masculine Hanbok palace look from Korea's official cultural fashion showcase

feminine.description: Jewel-tone silk, commanding posture, deep royal colors. This is the look you see worn by leading actresses in sageuk dramas — dignified, timeless, and striking.
feminine.alt: Rich jewel-tone court Hanbok worn at Korea's official cultural fashion showcase

masculine.description: The classic dopo robe worn by scholars and nobles. Wide, sweeping sleeves in deep traditional colors — exactly what you'd picture a Joseon nobleman wearing.
masculine.alt: Noble scholar dopo robe Hanbok at Korea's official cultural fashion showcase

feminine.description: The most dramatic look in the collection. Heavy silk, gold-thread embroidery, layers of ceremonial detail — this is the Hanbok worn at royal court ceremonies and high-fashion showcases.
feminine.alt: Grand ceremonial royal Hanbok with ornate gold embroidery from Korea's official fashion showcase

masculine.description: Full ceremonial grandeur — bold embroidered motifs, rich deep tones, and commanding presence. Reserved for the most significant occasions; unforgettable in photos.
masculine.alt: Grand ceremonial court Hanbok robe from Korea's official cultural fashion showcase
